caseNameFull: Lyons v. Klatte, State Hospital Superintendent
attorneys: Petitioner pro se., Thomas C. Lynch, Attorney General of California, and Robert R. Granucci and Jay S. Linderman, Deputy Attorneys General, for respondent.

opinions.text: Motion for leave to file petition for writ of habeas corpus denied. Treating the papers submitted as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
